purpose: Close the searchable PST archive ingestion loop by proving source coverage, reconciling later/current sources, and distinguishing unprocessed content from questions that require genuinely new or live authority.

structural_notes: The single Outlook.pst message-type record deduplicates into the same 576-message canonical corpus.
All message classes, not only ordinary IPM.Note email, were included in the independent re-audit.

Low-signal/unclassified material received a separate semantic review; most residual low-signal material was marketing, spam, phishing-like mail, tests, receipts or non-reusable personal/case material.
No additional safe reusable HR process domain emerged from the independent low-signal/source-class re-audit.

notes: Safe organization-level attachments were analyzed and modeled.
Restricted employee/applicant/medical/payroll/case attachments remain local/restricted and were not generalized into person-level GitHub records.
Generic image attachments received a visual audit; no hidden major policy, blank form or report source was found only in that image layer.
Calendar/meeting access links, passcodes and similar secrets are excluded from durable knowledge.
